text:
anna_devex: Hey — small PR to add a TypeScript streaming example to the SDK quickstart. No behavior changes, just docs + snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7123

sam_engineering: I can take a look in ~30m. Ping me if I don't show up.

jorge_docs: Quick skim: looks fine overall. One nit — the example uses fetch without error handling. Can you add a try/catch and a short note about Node 18+ for the streaming API?

anna_devex: Thanks! Added a try/catch and a note about Node 18 in latest commit (f3a9b2f). PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7123/commits/f3a9b2f

ci-bot: docs-build: passed ✅ link-check: passed ✅ (https://ci.redwood-infra/builds/7123)

lisa_pm: tiny wording suggestion, not blocking: change "streaming responses" -> "streamed responses" for consistency in the quickstart.

sam_engineering: Left one inline about an example timeout, optional. Approved :thumbsup:

jorge_docs: Approved from docs side. If CI stays green and sam's ok, feel free to merge.

anna_devex: Merging now. Thanks all :rocket:
